title: Beyond Inventory Lists Giving SMEs Greater Control Over Their Networks
summary: It helps SMEs identify gaps in their network visibility, keep track of inventory, and manage infrastructure changes with confidence as their networks evolve.
body_markdown:
What if you could see every device on your network in detail? For customers who have spent hours sifting through inventory lists manually or working with fragmented tools, that visibility can be a welcome relief.


Customers come to FatPipe because their teams and departments maintain separate files, and they want a single, reliable source of information. A couple of customers even shared how inaccurate data had frustrated their sales leaders. For SMEs operating with limited IT resources, these challenges become more pronounced as their businesses grow.


FatPipe helps address these challenges by updating the inventory when a device is replaced and maintaining a record of the connection status of unused devices. It also records the status of devices awaiting monitoring.


Maintaining an inventory is only part of the job. The inventory also needs to accurately reflect the network as it exists today.


**FatPipe’s Organized Approach to Network Inventory Management**


FatPipe Constellation provides a structured way to identify devices and add them for monitoring. Its Added/Removed Devices section consolidates network inventory changes across discovery scans, allowing users to compare two discovery snapshots and identify devices that have appeared or disappeared between them.


FatPipe also accounts for devices that have been discovered but are not yet being monitored.


The Unmonitored Devices section shows discovered network assets that are not part of the monitored inventory. Key details help IT teams assess these devices and determine which ones to prioritize for monitoring.


**The Constellation Advantage**


When something goes wrong, IT teams often need to piece together the network’s history. Constellation’s inventory management capabilities make that work easier by providing a clearer view of inventory changes and monitoring gaps.


**From Inventory Awareness to Operational Confidence**


FatPipe Constellation turns network inventory from a static record into an actionable view of discovered assets, changes, and monitoring priorities. It helps SMEs identify gaps in their network visibility, keep track of inventory, and manage infrastructure changes with greater confidence as their networks evolve.
